title: Tensor-normalized composition of algebraic-space module pullbacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $X,Y,Z$ be algebraic spaces over $S$, with their small etale sites and structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the tensor pullbacks, specified adjunction units and local tensor sections of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. For arbitrary morphisms $a:X\to Y$ and $b:Y\to Z$, define the canonical natural isomorphism $\gamma_{a,b}:a^*\circ b^*\simeq (b\circ a)^*$, by the following unique tensor normalization. For an etale scheme $V\to Z$, a chart $q=(T\to Y,T\to V)$ for $b$ over $V$, and a chart $r=(U\to X,U\to T)$ for $a$ over $T$, their composite chart for $b\circ a$ is $(U\to X,U\to T\to V)$; its triangle commutes by composition of the two chart triangles. For every module $M$ on $Z$, $c\in\mathcal O_X(U)$, $d\in\mathcal O_Y(T)$ and $m\in M(V)$, the component of $\gamma_{a,b}$ sends the iterated local tensor $c\otimes(d\otimes m)$ to $(c\,r^\sharp(d))\otimes m$ on this composite chart, where $r^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y(T)\to\mathcal O_X(U)$ is pullback of regular functions along $U\to T$. This condition determines a unique natural isomorphism; $\gamma_{a,b}$ is that isomorphism, not a choice of an unnormalized comparison.
